nodes.label: Chain lock (transaction-scoped advisory lock)
nodes.rationale: Taken before the id is drawn so a higher id never commits before a lower one; the syslog forwarder relies on this. Cost: audit writes are serialised.

nodes.label: Details cap and warden.truncated marker

nodes.label: Signed retention checkpoint (warden.audit.checkpoint.v1)

nodes.label: Syslog forwarding from committed rows (RFC 5424)
nodes.rationale: One elected forwarder tails the audit table from a stored cursor, so rolled-back events are never sent and a slow collector never blocks a request.
